Genres: Simulation,Indie. Tags: VR,Multiplayer,Survival,Simulation,Co-op,Horde Survival,Management. About: Welcome to the Bureau. You and your teammates are the last gravekeepers on the night shift, and the horde is coming back. Graveyard Shift Bureau is a multiplayer VR survival simulation where every minute on the clock matters.

Work together to run a cemetery office under pressure. Monitor the grounds on a wall of security screens, track each approaching wave, and keep the systems running. When the power flickers, rewire it and bring it back online before time runs out. Did you set it up right? If not, you will have to set it up again, and the clock will not wait.

Between waves, sit down in the boardroom, review your notes, and edit the records in the bureau's wiki. Every story you compile, every note you log, and every correction you make changes what your team knows about the next attack. A probation officer reviews your performance at the end of each night, and a tribunal decides whether your crew keeps its post.

Features:
- Cooperative VR play for multiple players
- Timed survival rounds against escalating hordes
- Monitoring stations, wiring puzzles, and emergency repairs
- A shared wiki editor that records the story of every shift
- Restart a night and try a different approa

negative.text: Genres: Simulation,Survival,Multiplayer. Tags: VR,Multiplayer,Survival,Bureaucracy,Time Management,Story Rich,Editor,Co-op. About: The Bureau’s archive is under siege. In this VR multiplayer survival simulation, reconnect the wires and reset the timers before the Horde reaches the boardroom. Each round is a race to keep the record alive: edit and compile wiki pages, stitch together clips and notes, and track timer updates as the story restarts. A disputed change can send you before the editor tribunal, where your team must decide what belongs in the archive and what needs to be recovered. Take on the work of a gravekeeper-editor, restoring damaged entries while probation officers and monitoring programs watch for mistakes. Coordinate across the room, keep the system running, and protect the story through its finale. Every repaired page buys time, but the Horde keeps coming—and a missed update can unravel the whole archive.

Genres: Action,Indie,Platformer,Free to Play. Tags: Free to Play,Dodge,Platformer,Combat,Retro,Burglary,Arcade,Level Up. About: Play Clemsonizer Vault Dodge, a free retro dodge platformer about burglary. Download free and slip into the vaults!

Every level is a game of squares. Hazards spin clockwise around each room, and you must time every jump to survive. Drop down through the ceiling, pass locked doors, climb over a fence and crack the vault before the guards catch you.

Fight with quick combat or dodge past enemies. Traps, switches and hidden doors keep each run fresh.

Each level is harder than the one before it. Finish a stage to earn a trophy, then replay earlier levels to collect the ones you missed. A boss waits at the end of every second vault, testing everything you have learned.

Features:
- Free to download and play
- Retro platform combat with precise dodging
- Clockwise square hazard patterns
- Vaults, doors and fences to get past
- Level progression with trophies to earn
- Short stages, easy to learn and hard to master

Leap across square platforms, duck beneath low ceilings and thread through doors as you make your way toward a guarded vault. Tight corridors leave little room to hesitate: dodge danger, fight when a route is blocked, and use pumps and shifting hazards to turn each room into a test of timing. Fences and locked doors complicate the getaway, so scout the layout and watch the simple on-screen overlay as you move through the building’s traditional infrastructure and machinery. Every level takes you deeper into the job, building toward a trophy for mastering the route. Quick reactions and careful platforming can get Vera in and out clean.

Start in a small workshop with a few basic materials and learn which ones suit each kind of ball. Every ball has its own construction, features and advantages, and you will need to balance strength, weight and bounce to get a perfect result.

Choose from a collection of classic designs, each with a history and a traditional use. Work through the assembly step by step, then try optional upgrades and extra parts to improve performance. Watch for construction complications, because a poor choice of material can cause energy loss and ruin a ball's flight.

Test your creations on the practice field, where every ball behaves according to its materials and build. Compare your results against earlier designs and see how each new version improves on its predecessors.

- Craft 16 different balls, from traditional handmade types to modern functional designs
- Collect and combine a wide range of materials
- Learn the strengths and properties of each material
- Unlock new workshop tools and a power-holder station

Genres: Simulation,Sports,Casual. Tags: Physics,Ball,Crafting,Sandbox. About: Step into a hands-on workshop devoted to the design, history, and practical use of balls. Choose materials, compare their strengths and properties, and build equivalent balls to see how construction changes their performance. Begin with classic forms, including traditional horned designs, or try a slim B-ball and the distinctive Baxter model. Each design has trade-offs: handmade assembly and familiar construction methods can offer useful qualities while bringing their own complications.

Create and compare a collection of up to 16 balls, then test them with a 250 W power-holder. Explore how regional traditions and real-world applications shape material choices, from everyday play to specialized uses. Study the features that made earlier designs popular, refine your own functional builds, and weigh each advantage against the demands of production. Experiment, test, and uncover how thoughtful design turns simple materials into objects made to move.

Genres: Simulation,Puzzle,Casual. Tags: Puzzle,Simulation,Escape Room,Cozy,Singleplayer,Editable,Cosmetic,English. About: Bluemen is a cozy puzzle simulation set inside a single locked cabin. It is your first time there, and the door has closed behind you. Escape by reading clues, decoding notes and editing the rooms around you.

Every object in the cabin is an editable piece of the puzzle. Open drawers, flip hidden switches, rearrange furniture and swap cosmetic items to reveal secret compartments. Some labels, keys and annotations are wrong on purpose, so check each clue twice before you trust it. A misplaced symbol or a missing character in a code can send you down the wrong path.

Each solved puzzle unlocks a new part of the cabin and brings you closer to the exit. Finish the escape, then return to decorate every room your own way.

Features:
- Escape-style puzzles woven into a relaxed simulation
- Cosmetic customization for every room
- Editable layouts that change how puzzles unfold
- Hidden codes, encoded notes and secret doors
- No timers and no penalties
- Full English text with a simple point-and-click interface

Take your time and see whether you can unravel every mystery the cabin holds.

negative.text: Genres: Simulation,Puzzle. Tags: Cabin,Escape Room,Cozy,Logic,Text Puzzles,XML. About: Welcome to Bluemen, a cheeky cabin simulation where every room hides a small escape mission. Make the cabin your own as you inspect its notes, labels, and annotations for clues. A misplaced key, an editable field, or a stubborn exit label can turn an ordinary object into the next puzzle. Read snippets of HTML and XML, follow IDs and localized strings, and repair what the cabin’s little marshaller has left behind. Some challenges ask you to spot an escape character; others lead through namespaces, empty entries, or a dismissible message that refuses to stay dismissed. Each clue belongs to the room around it, so look closely, experiment, and connect the text to the objects nearby. Whether you’re a first-time Bluemen or a seasoned tinkerer, take your time, solve each mission, and settle into a playful mix of cabin decorating and hands-on, language-based puzzling.

Visit residents' homes, hear their stories and earn their trust. Join the Partnership Program, a community effort founded fourteen years ago, and work with Joanna Fawerbuckle, a stubborn but caring guide who helps your family and neighbors.

Take on billable jobs to earn dollars, unlock animated scenes, and collect fan art inspired by a diverse cast of Japanese-style anime characters.

Features:
- Simulation, RPG and strategy gameplay in one story
- Team-based festival matches with defense and ball-handling roles
- A diverse anime cast in a historical colonial setting
- Animated scenes and fan art gallery

positive.text: Title: Sparse Reconstruction Algorithms with Graph Neural Networks. Abstract: High-level vision systems use deep learning to predict how real-world systems evolve over time, but their predictions can be unreliable when observations are sparse. We present a software architecture for reconstructing missing information with graph neural networks. The system represents entities as nodes, relationships as edges, and available measurements as graph signals. A gated message-passing module combines observed signals with neighboring context to estimate unobserved states, then passes the reconstructed graph to a temporal prediction model. We describe the architecture and its implementation, and evaluate reconstruction quality and prediction performance as the proportion of observed data varies. Experiments on graph-structured vision tasks assess how reconstruction affects downstream forecasts. The evaluation characterizes the conditions under which graph-based reconstruction supports temporal modeling with limited measurements. This work contributes an integrated design methodology connecting sparse reconstruction algorithms, graph neural network modeling, and future-state prediction in high-level vision systems.

negative.text: Title: Sparse Reconstruction Algorithms with Graph Neural Networks for Predicting the Remaining Lifetimes of Real-World Systems. Abstract: High-level vision system models today rely heavily on data science frameworks based on deep learning to predict the future lifetimes of real-world systems. Such frameworks often require dense measurements and large training sets, which limits their use when observations are incomplete or noisy. This paper studies sparse reconstruction algorithms built on graph neural networks, in which sensors or system components are represented as nodes of a graph and the learned model recovers missing signals from a small subset of observations. We also contribute to software architecture design methodology by describing a modular implementation that separates data ingestion, graph construction, reconstruction, and prediction, so that each stage can be replaced or extended independently. The approach is evaluated experimentally against dense baselines, and we summarize the implementation, the methodology, and the resulting contributions. Results indicate that sparse reconstruction with graph neural networks preserves predictive accuracy while reducing the amount of data required, and that the proposed architecture makes such pipelines easier to maintain and reuse.

positive.text: Title: Triangle Closing for Recruiter Search on LinkedIn: Location-Aware Candidate Retrieval Across Cities and Metropolitan Areas. Abstract: Recruiters on LinkedIn search for candidates across many cities and metropolitan areas, yet location and job-title fields are noisy and inconsistent. We study recruiter search as link prediction on a heterogeneous graph of recruiters, candidates, jobs, companies, and locations, using triangles as the central structural signal. Our method scores a recruiter-candidate pair by counting closed triples through shared employers, industries, and areas. We normalize location strings and job-title variants and feed the triangle counts into a ranking model. On a large offline dataset of recruiter interactions, the approach improves ranking quality over text-only and embedding baselines, especially for rare titles and small areas. Ablations show that location-aware triangles account for most of the gain.

negative.text: Title: Triangles Conquer Recruiter via LI. Abstract: We study triangle-based candidate discovery for recruiters on LinkedIn (LI). Recruiters, candidates, and organizations form a heterogeneous graph, where a triangle represents mutually reinforcing connections among these entities. We score recruiter–candidate links using local triangle patterns alongside profile and employment signals, then rank candidates for outreach. This approach favors candidates supported by multiple paths through the network while retaining useful evidence from sparse neighborhoods. Recommendations can be interpreted through the shared connections and organizational context contributing to each score. The source draft contains no recoverable dataset, benchmark, or quantitative findings; accordingly, this description makes no performance claims and frames the contribution as a graph-based method and evaluation protocol for recruiter–candidate interactions.
